title: ClassSessionCancelled
description: Hold aflyst: a class session will not take place. Published by Booking, consumed by Notification (docs/domain/CONTEXT-MAP.md section 5). The message carries the correlation ID in its X-Correlation-ID header, not in the body.

classSessionId.description: The id of the class session. A class session is cancelled once, so consumers use it, with the member id per notice, to handle the same event only once.

memberIds.description: The members who had a reservation or a waitlist entry (MemberId, from Membership). May be empty.

startTime.description: When the class session was going to start, ISO 8601 with an offset.
